summary: This Phase 3 clinical trial compares how different medications affect insulin resistance and blood sugar control in overweight adults with newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes. Researchers are testing metformin, dapagliflozin, and a combination of metformin and pioglitazone. The study aims to see which treatment best improves insulin sensitivity in the body. A total of 60 participants are expected to take part in this research.
